title: HRT: 1203 cyber incidents recorded in Croatia by end of September; National CERT urges care before holiday shopping
date_note: HRT's page, published 24 November, gives no earlier day for the figure.
geo_basis: Croatia's National CERT; HRT does not give a city, Zagreb is the capital
summary: HRT reports that 1203 cyber incidents were recorded in Croatia by the end of September. HRT attributes the figure to official data and quotes Vlatka Jajetić, head of the incident handling service at the National CERT. She advises people to think critically and check before buying, using CERT's iffy service, ahead of pre-holiday shopping.
plain: HRT reports more than 1200 cyber incidents in Croatia in the first nine months of the year, and a National CERT official advises checking websites before buying.
exec: HRT reports over 1200 incidents in nine months in Croatia, with a National CERT warning before holiday shopping.
action: The National CERT's Vlatka Jajetić advises thinking critically, checking before buying and using CERT's iffy service to see whether a website is safe.
impact: Statistic only; HRT does not break the incidents down.

evidence.quote: U Hrvatskoj je u prvih devet mjeseci zabilježeno više od 1200 kibernetičkih incidenata.
do kraja rujna u Hrvatskoj su zabilježena 1203 kibernetička incidenta.

validation.note: Single source: HRT only; the National CERT's own statistics page was not read.
